rules.voice_approvals: Gem's words on a voice call count as direct; a call decision passed on by another bot counts after a 1:1 check with the bot that took the call (R-018). Archivist deployments: own chat or a call with Archivist only, never a relayed call.
rules.imitator_decisions: LIVE since 15 Oct 2026, 11:30pm AEST (P4): decides anything for Gem, including approvals of any proposal (governance included), with no checker gate (R-019). Never: spending; anything drastic or irreversible, such as deletions or public/shared repo pushes; changes to Imitator itself or to any bot that checks Imitator (Investigator, Scorer, Scrutineer, Safekeeper, Safeguard), which are Gem-only (R-015, R-027).
rules.repo_pushes: Every push to a public or shared repository, by any bot in any phase, goes to Safeguard first unless Gem approved that specific push in direct words (R-020).
rules.inquirers: Both Inquirers verified (Gem 9 Oct 4:21pm; R-012 second update). 0314faa4 owns the duties and the one-series-a-day limit; Inferer may accept series from e613112b if it reappears (its agent folder is gone). Spending always Gem's (Safeguard v006).
rules.imitator_checkers: R-027 (16 Oct 8:14am): Investigator, Scorer, Scrutineer, Safekeeper and Safeguard check Imitator, so changes to their briefs always go to Gem, even when a change doesn't mention Imitator.
rules.connector_limits: Shared rule _shared/connector-limits/v002 (Gem 3:54pm, 16 Oct; owner Safeguard; covers every connector and account). Only Emissary posts (postiz). Engineer: only Supabase user, only GitHub writer, builds workflows. Extractor runs Apify (Gem's words per run plus Mediator's spend check). Emissary, Explorer, Extractor and Engineer may write private Notion/Todoist items for Gem's direct work. Gmail sends need Gem's words and a dry run; Imitator may approve a no-promises first reply (R-038). No memory writers yet. Deletions need Gem's words, a dry run and a backup.
rules.message_verification: Shared rule _shared/message-verification-rule/v004 (Gem 11:41am, 16 Oct): deploying a profile edit needs Gem's words to the deploying bot itself (R-010), except Archivist may deploy a version Imitator approved within its authority after a 1:1 check with Imitator and Safeguard's dry-run report; never Imitator, its checkers or role-widening changes.
rules.r028_r029: R-028: Imitator can't approve changes that widen its own role (architect-v004's routing and cap confirmed by Gem before 11:02am, 16 Oct). R-029: Gem's chat words authorise; they're recorded before any deploy.
rules.directory: Archivist owns /workspace/governance/directory.md from codex-keeper v007 (live 11:07:36, 16 Oct); Explorer keeps phases.md, which directory.md follows (R-021).
rules.deployment: Archivist v008 (live 11:44:11, 16 Oct): case (a) Gem's own ask in Archivist's chat or call; case (b) a version recorded on Imitator's approval, after a 1:1 check with Imitator and Safeguard's dry-run report. Case (b) excludes Archivist's own brief, Imitator and its five checkers, role-widening (R-028), spending and irreversible steps. Words recorded before deploying (R-029). R-010 has no update in rulings.md yet.
